findings.scenario: Observe whether Reported capability gains in high-risk domains alongside measured safeguard failures and autonomous operation moves in the direction of concern: Capability improvement outpacing independent evaluations, incident reporting, and defense-in-depth
findings.observationCadence: monthly evidence scan and on each international report update
findings.measurableTrigger: A verified high-severity incident, a new dangerous capability evaluation, or material safeguard regression
findings.boundedResponse: Maintain an evidence-separated capability, incident, and safeguard registry with preregistered update criteria
findings.rollback: Revert disputed classifications to unverified and preserve the challenged evidence and reviewer rationale
findings.authorityBoundary: Automation may analyze public evidence, test local non-deployed controls, and prepare reviewable changes. It may not access restricted systems, release hazardous capability details, or deploy autonomous agents without a bounded authority assessment; humans are an exceptional escalation endpoint, not routine operators.
